name: Windows Settings Manager Lite
description:
Put the Windows controls you actually change on Stream Deck.

Windows Settings Manager Lite gives you a focused set of live system controls instead of a page of random commands. See and control HDR on Windows 11 24H2 or later, plus the active Windows power plan, display topology, screen and sleep timeouts, Keep Awake, and Lock PC.

Keys re-read Windows state, so changes made in Windows itself are reflected instead of assuming PackRat was the last thing to touch the setting. There is no coordinate clicking, Quick Settings automation, or hidden mouse movement.

Includes editable starter profiles for Stream Deck, Stream Deck Mini, Stream Deck XL, Stream Deck +, Stream Deck Neo, Galleon 100 SD, and Stream Deck + XL. Upgrade to Pro when you want multiple settings combined into saved PC Modes.

Requires Windows and Stream Deck 7.3 or later. HDR control requires Windows 11 24H2 or later plus compatible display hardware and drivers; the other controls remain available on supported Windows 10/11 systems.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes:
- Live HDR, power plan, display topology, screen/sleep timeout, and Keep Awake controls.
- Lock PC plus a live Windows system status action.
- External Windows changes refresh back onto Stream Deck keys.
- Editable starter profiles for seven current Stream Deck device families, including Galleon 100 SD and Stream Deck + XL.
